# TC-CLI-266 config get/set：未配置时 get 返回默认仓库；set 后 get 读回新值并落盘

env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg
env HOME=$WORK/home

exec databackup --json config get
cmpenv stdout want-default.jsonl

exec databackup --json config set repo $WORK/repo
cmpenv stdout want-set.jsonl
exists $WORK/xdg/databackup/config.json

exec databackup --json config get repo
cmpenv stdout want-set.jsonl

exec databackup config get repo
cmpenv stdout want-human.txt

-- want-default.jsonl --
{"type":"result","command":"config","repo":"$WORK/home/DataBackup"}
-- want-set.jsonl --
{"type":"result","command":"config","repo":"$WORK/repo"}
-- want-human.txt --
$WORK/repo
